prompt: Create an original 90 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 56 BPM; G major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective orchestral piece featuring prominent woodwind melodies over a rich string and brass accompaniment. The music builds gently with a sense of longing and drama.
